title: The Wish
goal: Tell the AI what kind of game you want to make.
mascot_lines: Last chapter! THIS is where it all comes together.
We are going to make a REAL game.
First, you have to tell the AI what you want.
What kind of game? What can the hero do?

tier2.rephrase: Type a wish that includes 'jump' and 'world'.

tier3.nudge: Try: 'I want a hero who can run and jump in a world with levels'.

sandbox.hint: Tell Claude what kind of game you want!

payload.prompt: Tell Claude your wish. Use the word 'jump' in your message:
payload.target_display: I want a hero who can ___ and ___ in a world with ___
payload.hint_wrong: Use the word 'jump' somewhere in your wish.
